daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿لِإِيلافِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the later verb ليعبدوا. ﴿قُرَيْشٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿إِيلافِهِمْ﴾ a badal (substitute) from what precedes it. ﴿رِحْلَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun). ﴿الشِّتاءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالصَّيْفِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الشتاء.

daas-irab:3-3.t: [Translator's note: the word markers in the source text of this entry are garbled; the Quranic words are restored here as ﴿فَلْيَعْبُدُوا﴾, ﴿رَبَّ هذَا﴾ and ﴿الْبَيْتِ﴾.] ﴿فَلْيَعْبُدُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبَّ هذَا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), muḍāf to the demonstrative. ﴿الْبَيْتِ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, a badal (substitute) from رب. ﴿أَطْعَمَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ جُوعٍ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَآمَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.
